sources.title: Chad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's live official Chad travel advisory directly classifies holders of Serbian national passports as visa required. It is used to establish that the ordinary Serbian passport is a non-exempt visitor passport, not to infer an unlisted nationality category.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For holders of national passports and other travel documents: Visa required

sources.title: New visa tariffs in the Republic of Chad
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration and Emigration, Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.td notice identifies the Directorate of Immigration and Emigration and its eVisa subdirectorate. It states that every new visa application has been exclusively online through the official platform since 11 May 2026, except diplomatic and courtesy visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td.

sources.title: Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's live official Sudan advisory expressly applies its visa regime to national passports of both states and identifies Sudan's Bucharest diplomatic-consular mission as responsible for issuing visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The diplomatic consular mission of Sudan in Romania is responsible for issuing visas.

sources.title: Syria, Arab Republic
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's live official Syria advisory directly says Serbian citizens need a visa and identifies the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade as the advance-issuance route. It separately warns that the formal border route has been uncertain since hostilities began.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the Republic of Serbia require a visa for entering Syria, obtainable at the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade.

sources.title: Trinidad and Tobago
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's live official Trinidad and Tobago advisory directly identifies holders of Serbian passports and states the ordinary short-stay visa waiver and duration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of Serbian passports do not need a visa for stays of up to 30 days.

sources.title: Turkmenistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's live official Turkmenistan advisory directly applies to Serbian national passports and says border or airport issuance requires a State Migration Service-issued invitation letter. That advance invitation/preapproval prevents the route from characterizing every ordinary Serbian passport holder.
sources.supportingExcerpt: an invitation letter (original or photocopy) from a legal entity or individual, issued in the prescribed manner

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Consulate General of Italy in Vancouver, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
sources.officialityEvidence: Italy's live official consular guidance explains that Vatican City keeps an open border with neighbouring Schengen countries and that public travel necessarily transits a Schengen country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vatican City microstates maintain open borders with neighbouring Schengen countries.

sources.title: Countries exempt from visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
sources.officialityEvidence: Italy's live MFA short-stay list names Serbia but limits the waiver to biometric passports and expressly excludes passports issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate. This is a material document split not encoded by the RS passport code.
sources.supportingExcerpt: the visa waiver applies only to the holders of biometric passports.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, consolidated 30 December 2025
sources.officialityEvidence: The in-force consolidated EU Visa Regulation confirms that Serbia's exemption applies only to biometric passports and excludes Serbian Coordination Directorate passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The exemption from the visa requirement shall apply only to holders of biometric passports.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly requires a visa for Serbian national passports, and Chad's current immigration authority requires all new non-diplomatic visa applications exclusively through evisa.td.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Serbian-passport short visitors, which Serbia's MFA directly identifies as visa required.
Submit the new visa request exclusively through evisa.td before travel; diplomatic and courtesy visas remain outside this electronic route.
Purpose, security checks, duration, final admission, transit, work, residence, official, diplomatic and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

application.label: Chad official eVisa application
steps: Submit the new visitor-visa request through evisa.td before travel.
Complete the electronic application and any requested immigration checks.
Travel only with the approved visa and required admission documents.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA says the bilateral visa regime applies to national passports and identifies Sudan's Bucharest diplomatic-consular mission as responsible for issuing visas.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian national passport for a short visit.
Obtain the entry visa through Sudan's competent diplomatic-consular mission in Bucharest before travel; Serbia's MFA says the described route requires a Sudanese inviter or host.
Mission availability, security, sponsor verification, final admission, transit, work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Syria advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly requires a visa for Serbian citizens and identifies the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade as the available advance-issuance route.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for a short visitor trip.
Obtain the visa at the Syrian Embassy in Belgrade before travel. Serbia's MFA says the formal border route has been uncertain since hostilities began.
Mission availability, security, final admission, transit, work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Serbia's MFA directly says Serbian passport holders do not need a Trinidad and Tobago visa for stays up to 30 days.
conditions: Applies to holders of Serbian ordinary passports for stays up to 30 days.
Purpose, passport validity, return arrangements, final admission, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside this policy.
